org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

segments.description: The session's turns, split into contiguous segments. A segment break marks a gap the rollout should not pretend was continuous.

commits.description: Every commit this session was attributed to.

attribution_source.description: How the underlying attribution was established.

terminal_outcomes.description: The CI outcomes that supply the trajectory's terminal verifier results.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

split.description: Which side of the deterministic eval split this row is on, hashed on `session_id` so a session never straddles both.

session_commit_observations.description: Captured Facts matching this Session and its repository-qualified commits at the derivation boundary. These Facts do not prove individual-call authorship.

new_messages.description: Only the messages this turn added, so a trajectory does not repeat the whole history per turn.

decisions.description: The developer decisions recorded against this completion.

inference_call_id.description: Id of the inference call this record belongs to.

tool_calls.description: The tool calls this turn's response made.

role.description: The message author role, such as `system`, `user`, `assistant`, or `tool`.

parts.description: Ordered text, reasoning, tool-call, or tool-response parts.

finish_reason.description: The model service's finish reason when reported.

content.description: Plain text, without JSON encoding around it.
Readable model reasoning. Opaque provider state remains on the fact's `raw` payload.

id.description: The agent-visible tool-call id. It is separate from `model_call_id`.

arguments.description: The parsed argument object. Malformed wire arguments become `{}`; the original stays on `InferenceCall.raw`.

id.description: The tool-call id this result answers.

result.description: The structured tool result supplied to the model.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

user_id.description: The developer identity when known. Null when capture omitted it.

agent_harness.description: Which coding agent harness produced this fact.

file_path.description: The file edited, or empty string when the client emits none — common on rejects.

accepted.description: Whether the developer took the change.

explicit.description: True for a real human gesture; false for auto-applied or inferred. Implicit decisions move confidence but never classify a row.

interaction_mode.description: Whether the edit interaction was `agent` or `inline`.

commit_sha.description: The commit the client attributed, when it knew one.

call_id.description: The provider's per-call id, joining this record back to the inference call that produced it. Null when the provider emits none.

edit_retention_score.description: Graded preference strength in [0, 1]: how much applied edit text remains in a later file observation. Null unless capture or derivation supplies it.

observation_delay_ms.description: The delay before the edit retention score was observed. Null unless the harness reports one.

occurred_at.description: When the developer acted, stamped client-side. Required — it is what makes a redelivery collapse, and is never backfilled.

captured_at.description: When Sediment stored the fact, stamped server-side. Windows and ordering anchor on this, never on a client clock.

raw.description: The source payload after Basic redaction, kept so a translator defect stays recoverable. Shape varies by provider; never join on it.

commit_sha.description: The full commit identity within that repository.

schema_version.description: The normalized fact-contract version. CI outcomes use 1.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

provider.description: The normalized CI system selected by a capture adapter or declared by the bearer-authenticated vendor integration.

run_id.description: The provider-issued pipeline-run id, unique within the deployment organization and provider namespace.

run_attempt.description: The positive provider attempt number. Null when the provider omits it.

repo.description: `owner/repo`, lowercased. Empty string when the sender omitted it.

branch.description: The branch the run or commit belongs to.

workflow_id.description: The provider's stable workflow or pipeline-definition identity.

workflow_path.description: The workflow definition's repo-relative path — the stable identity a display name does not give you. Null when unreported.

run_url.description: Link to the run in the CI system. Null when unreported; never run identity.

provider_result.description: The exact terminal value reported by the provider before normalization.

error_type.description: A structured, low-cardinality provider error type. Null when absent.

reason.description: A bounded, Basic-redacted provider reason. Null when absent.

source_event_type.description: The source contract and event type. Null when unreported.

source_spec_version.description: The source contract version. Null when unreported.

source_event_id.description: The provider or standard source event identity. Null when unreported.

pr_number.description: The pull request the run belongs to, when there is one.

captured_at.description: When Sediment stored the fact, stamped server-side. Windows and ordering anchor on this, never on a client clock.

raw.description: The source payload after Basic redaction, kept so a translator defect stays recoverable. Shape varies by provider; never join on it.

quarantine_revision.description: The integer quarantine-log high-water mark used for the derivation.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 of the fully resolved derivation policy when available.

schema_version.description: The Git-note observation Fact contract version. Fixed at 1.

observation_id.description: Stable id for this Session-to-commit observation.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

repo.description: The non-empty `owner/repo` that owns the observed commit, lowercased.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

source_push_id.description: The Push that triggered this Git-note observation.

captured_at.description: When Sediment stored the fact, stamped server-side. Windows and ordering anchor on this, never on a client clock.
